title: Passage
description: One row of data/passages.jsonl (local, includes text) or data/passages_index.csv (committed, no text).

entity_in_title.description: Vendor named in the page title or the headings above the passage. True with entity_explicit false is the detachment case: the page identifies the source, the passage alone does not.

text.description: Local file only. Stripped from the committed index.

entity_mentions.description: Vendor or product names from vendors.yaml

other_vendor_mentions.description: Names of other study vendors in the passage. Comparison pages put two brands in one passage, where misattribution is most likely.

first_person_refs.description: we, our, us: brand voice that loses its referent once chunked

pronoun_refs.description: Third-person pronouns and demonstratives that may point outside the passage

generic_refs.description: the platform, the tool, the product, and similar

unresolved_ref_rate.description: (first person + pronoun + generic refs) per sentence. A heuristic until a coreference model is wired in.
